name: Installed fonts via measurement
plain: Detects which fonts are installed by measuring text width, no permission needed.
meaning: Shows OS, office suites and design tools installed (Adobe, Microsoft Office add fonts). FingerprintJS tests dozens of fonts against 3 fallbacks; list entropy was 13.9 bits in 2016.

web.api: canvas.measureText(), offsetWidth of spans per font-family

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: detected fonts
fields.range: dozens to hundreds of candidate names tested

limits.headline: Can tell which fonts you have installed by measuring text, with no prompt
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: Test dozens of font names to see which ones are present
Spot software that adds fonts, like Office or Adobe tools
Tell your operating system apart from others
Use the font list as a strong tell for tracking you
cannot: List every font in one call; it tests names one by one
See your font files or documents
See which apps you actually use
Work for fonts the site does not think to test

story.what_it_is: Finds out which fonts you have installed by measuring text sizes.
story.for_you: You never see it. A page draws hidden text in dozens of fonts and measures how wide each one is. Your answer reveals your system and software, such as Microsoft Office or Adobe tools.
story.for_makers: Font lists are one of the most unique things about a device. Trackers use them to recognise a visitor without cookies. Design tools use a similar method to show which fonts a person has.

use_cases.example: A fingerprinting service tests dozens of fonts and mixes the result into a device ID that survives cookie clearing.
A fraud tool compares the font list with the claimed operating system and flags a mismatch.
A browser design tool such as Figma checks which fonts you have so designs show correctly.
An online document editor warns that a font is missing on your device.
An ad network keeps a long-lived ID from your font list to connect your visits across sites.
A browser game checks fonts to choose the best looking interface text.

technical_bounds: Cannot enumerate arbitrary fonts, only test names
Local Font Access API needs a permission

linkedin.how: Installed fonts and Flash font detection. Read by the LinkedIn APFC fingerprint script (48 features, alleged by BrowserGate, partly confirmed by BleepingComputer).
